notes.title: Update for June 24, 2023
notes.notes:
[b]Update for June 24, 2023:[/b]
+ updated race track 3 (added a wooden bridge before the finish line)
+ fixed rim holes for all wheels
+ improved driving stability

1. The Steam Summer Sale will start in a few days. During this event, we want to add [u]a new race track[/u] (early next month).

2. After that it will be time for [u]the new Challenge mode[/u]. At first, I think it will be a 10 short challenges with leaderboards. And more later. 

Waiting your ideas for it!
